content:
Hi,
I just tried submitting a formalization to Palomar, and got this message:

leanprover/lean4export has published no v4.33.1 release

Palomar must fix this.

Next: Do not change the repository. Palomar must add support for this Lean release.

Is this because v4.33.1 is not supported? I don't have strong preferences about which version to use, and believe my project should work with any recent version. I also tried submitting with the 4.34 release candidate, and got a somewhat different error message. (I would like to use a release no farther back than v4.33.1, since I understand there were serious kernel soundness bugs in previous releases.)

Thank you!
Thanks for this bug report. I fixed the same issue for Verso, but somehow missed it for lean4export. Fixing now. (Updated: Fixed.)

Thank you! I just tried resubmitting the same project. Now I get a different error:

/home/runner/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.33.1/bin/lake build failed (1): error: build failed

Palomar must fix this.

Next: Do not change the repository. Retry the same commit later; report the workflow URL if the problem recurs.
I tried resubmitting my (unchanged) repo today and got the same lake build error message.

Is there any info about which versions of lean are currently supported?
(I tried submitting the same repo referenced above just now, and got the same error. It looks to me from the error message like v4.33.1 is not supported, thought that's really just a guess.)
I looked at a few recently registered projects, and they all seem to be using version 4.32 or earlier, which doesn't seem ideal given the known issues with those...

toolchains.json has "minimum": "v4.28.0" as the only constraint.

(However, it's currently broken on v4.28.0–v4.30.0 see https://github.com/PalomarRegistry/PalomarSubmission/issues/133)

Kim: I'm not sure what your testing setup is, but might be worth having an end-to-end test in CI checking that it actually works end to end as advertised in toolchains.json, so this type of issue could be caught automatically.

Sorry for the misleading “retry unchanged” advice. I’ve reproduced the failure with better diagnostics: the submitted commit asks for Lean 4.33.1, but lake-manifest.json resolves Mathlib to 81a5d257…, which uses Lean 4.32.0. The replay fails while compiling dependencies.

Please regenerate the manifest against your declared Mathlib v4.33.1 dependency (lake update mathlib), commit it, and check a fresh build before resubmitting. Diagnostic replay. We also have an early version-mismatch diagnostic in preparation.
